name: Variant Armor Foundry
backstory: Three contrasting combat frames keep the foundry ready for changing brackets. A flexible lead, a mobile skirmisher and a heavy contact machine divide the upgrades.
strategy_personality: Robot-fighting-game heritage makes this an excellent thematic match. Treat the related games as one candidate family here; confirm the other machine names during blueprint work. [Capcom's Blodia reference](https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/capcom-snapshots-robots).

robots.name: Blodia
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.


Subject: Authentic Cyberbots BX-02 Blodia default red Variant Armor, iconic squat massive fighting-mech body, broad red shoulder plates, small recessed head with light sensor, immense articulated punching arms and thick short mechanical legs. Preserve Capcom's rounded industrial 1995 design, heavy feet, original blue/dark-metal accents. No human pilot or additional handheld weapon.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #124 slot 1 Blodia.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Blodia fills the flexible line fighter role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Versatile tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 15% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Generalist strategy tuning rules with the Versatile Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Cyberbots / Armored Warriors  
**Strategy:** Generalist · **Target roster:** 3 robots

**Catalogue key:** `variant-armor-foundry`

**Proposed robots:** Blodia; Reptos; Guldin.

**Direction:** Robot-fighting-game heritage makes this an excellent thematic match. Treat the related games as one candidate family here; confirm the other machine names during blueprint work. [Capcom's Blodia reference](https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/capcom-snapshots-robots).

**Production edition:** Cyberbots: Fullmetal Madness — 1995 arcade default Variant Armors. Custom arena names and equipment are adaptations; source machine identities remain as specified.
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–2; recruit slot 3 with its complete stage-0 loadout. Complete stage-1 loadouts in slot order. Refine the slot-1 lead only: verified Hone/Augment operations, then a first Sharpen at Workshop L5 and 3,000 prestige. Other slots have explicit empty refinement plans.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
